    long double x, y;
    int n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    long double p = 0.0L;
    long double s = 1.0L;

    long double i = 1.0L;
    while (i <= n) {
        long double v = q * i;
        long double a = floor(v);
        long long t = (long long)ceil(v);

        if (abs(q - a / i) < abs(q - p / s)) {

            s = i;
        }
        if (abs(q - t / i) < abs(q - p / s)) {
            p = t;
            s = i;
        }

        i += 1.0L;
    }

    cout << p << '/' << s;
